speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
question: What tends seven and thirty-six?
premises: Cultivated by seven-knowerhood, by thirty-six count — he, great Lord: glory-of-release proceeds.
inference: Tended means, Lord tends, release-glory proceeds.

speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
question: Are stages certain?
premises: Its stages — views and the rest, all, no doubt.
Made-up are stages: as an actor assumes by own will, so bliss-will-spread self assumes vast views-powers.
inference: Stages doubtless yet made-up, assumed like actor's roles.

speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
question: How does the impure shine?
premises: Bliss-spread self, assumed vast views-powers, shines.
From own-power-tightening, in wandering, it gets impure.
inference: Vast-assumed shines; tightened-power impures in wandering.

speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
question: What does the incomplete confess?
inference: Incompleteness confessed, defiled, yet all-pervading Lord.

speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
question: Who does the five acts?
premises: All-pervading — as the great god does five acts, so this self too does, power-deluded.
inference: As god does five, so self does, power-deluded.

speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
question: What is he called?
premises: Capable — from expansion, power-Lord is sung by truth-teachers.
From contraction, contracted, as wanderer is called.

speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
question: What does māyā will?
premises: Māyā — form indeed — which, somewhat to perceive intent, should know as made-creation.
Other power — preservation considered; from dissolution withdrawn goddess considered.
inference: Māyā willing perception; other powers considered.

speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
question: What grace in unity?
premises: From dissolution withdrawn goddess — in unity-of-consciousness grace considered.
From manifesting that essence, concealment called.
inference: Withdrawn goddess graces unity; concealment named of manifesting.

speaker: Kṣemarāja (teacher voice)
question: What jewel from ignorance?
premises: Thus always present five-course, in order known — wish-jewel.
That from ignorance — like wood and clod.
inference: Present course known as jewel; ignorance wood-clod.
